## 3. Computing the actual preparation boundary

A norm estimate alone would not complete the operation. We also need to calculate the surviving functionals of the actual buffer state.

The new finite-duration construction does this for **general multiqubit GKLS dynamics**, without the positive common-unitary representation that failed previously.

### 3.1 Local finite differences

Fix any normalized duration bound \(S\) independent of \(n,B,\epsilon,\delta\). Anchor all microscopic terms at spatial sites. Each anchored group has fixed support size and bounded induced Heisenberg norm
\[
\|G_x(s)^*\|_{\infty\to\infty}\leq\Gamma,
\qquad
\Gamma=2d_0G+2+d_0.
\]

For a short slab, let \(U_J^*\) denote the evolution retaining anchor groups in \(J\), and define
\[
F_I(A)=
\sum_{J\subseteq I}(-1)^{|I|-|J|}U_J^*(A).
\]

Interpolating the group strengths through \([0,1]\) preserves GKLS form. Every intervening adjoint propagator is therefore a unital CP contraction. Mixed Duhamel derivatives give
\[
\boxed{
\|F_I(A)\|_\infty
\leq(\Gamma\Delta s)^{|I|}\|A\|_\infty.
}
\tag{12}
\]
The \(|I|!\) insertion orders cancel the time-simplex factorial.

Every selected interaction component disjoint from \(\operatorname{supp}A\) cancels exactly: its Heisenberg evolution fixes the identity. Thus the algorithm enumerates rooted connected sets, whose number at order \(q\), for \(r\) roots, is at most
\[
C_b^{r+q}
\]
for an explicit fixed \(C_b\).

Choose
\[
\Delta s\leq(8C_b\Gamma)^{-1}.
\]
Then truncation at
\[
q=O_{\rm class}(r+\log\xi^{-1})
\]
controls the operator-norm error. Each retained term acts on only
\(O_{\rm class}(r+q)\) sites and is evaluated using rational finite matrices and certified exponentials.

A fixed number of slabs covers \(S\). Explicit support, coefficient-mass and precision recurrences give deterministic cost
\[
\boxed{
\exp\!\left[C_{\rm class,S}(r+\log\xi^{-1})\right]
\operatorname{poly}(n,B).
}
\tag{13}
\]

This operation accepts a **dense Hermitian contraction on its retained support**, which is important for the later join.

The construction has the connected-expansion character of short-time simulation methods, but the GKLS activation proof above supplies the needed contract directly. Existing Hamiltonian short-time and volume-tail results retain their own assumptions. [arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.11490?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
